Even on the fast branch (dt_s=0.002 -> tau=6.0s, r_max=6.0 MW/s), an abrupt 0->100 MW cold start combined with full-depth 0.1 Hz cycling (period_s=10.0s) produces 10.89 MW peak FFT bin at 0.1 Hz, exceeding the 10.0 MW limit.
Boundary step dt_s=0.1 hits dt >= 0.1 (tau=2.0s, r_max=15.0 MW/s) while resolving the entire 0.1-5.0 Hz band (Nyquist=5 Hz); 0.125 Hz (period_s=8.0s) reaches 10.66 MW > 10.0 MW.
